research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Valar Labs is engaged in developing systems and methods for an artificial intelligence based pathology platform, as described in Predicting patient outcomes related to pancreatic cancer. This platform is designed to provide prognostic value to clinicians by predicting outcomes related to pancreatic cancer using histological samples. Their research and development focus on AI-driven tools to assist cancer treatment decisions and improve clinical prognostic capabilities.

product_launches.description: Valar Labs is making its new AI diagnostic test, Vitara Pancreas ChemoPredict, available under early access so oncologists can select optimal first-line chemotherapy for advanced pancreatic cancer patients.

overview_description.description: Valar Labs makes AI to interpret solid tumors and deliver insights, so physicians and patients can make informed treatment decisions.  Their AI algorithms analyze digitized pathology slides to assess spatial features, and they design transparent systems grounded in underlying biology so physicians can trust the results.

product.name: Vesta Bladder
product.description: An AI-powered pathology diagnostic that analyzes routine histology slides to predict response to intravesical BCG treatment and assess disease risk in high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer.

product.name: Vitara Pancreas ChemoPredict
product.description: An AI-powered pathology test that classifies advanced pancreatic cancer tumors as favoring gemcitabine-based or 5-FU-based chemotherapy to support first-line regimen selection.

product.name: Vesta Prostate
product.description: An AI-based pathology diagnostic in Valar Labs’ Vesta portfolio that uses tumor histology to generate treatment-response and prognostic insights for prostate cancer.

product.name: Pharmaceutical and Biopharma Partnership Services
product.description: Collaborative AI pathology services for pharmaceutical companies, including biomarker discovery, diagnostic deployment, and automated molecular-biomarker screening.
